about:
A versatile, dedicated and passionate Dean’s List fourth year Information Technology Cybersecurity student at George Mason University with experience working in highly secure environments. I have direct experience and exposure and experience many different tech domains such as programming (SQL, HTML, Java, JavaScript, and Nodejs), network configuration, and network analysis, as well as gaining knowledge on different network protocols (HTTP, FTP, SSH), security standards (ISO, PCI-DSS), IT audits, and Cryptographic algorithms (DES, Diffie-Hellman, RSA). In addition to building skills in the classroom I have also obtained the
CompTIA Security+ certification, validating my knowledge in Cyber Security, and in process of obtaining Scrum certification.
